solutions.check: grid rebuilt from the blog's light list (unique); every answer written into it with each crossing agreeing

clue.text: One gathers exercise stretches back

indicators.note: the word back is stretched open so that exercise fits within it

parts.note: the back of something is its rear
PE is physical education, school exercise

explanation.surface: Someone doing exercises and stretching their back after a workout.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Stretches' reads as limbering up, but it means the back is pulled open to hold the exercise.
explanation.definitionFit: A reaper harvests crops, gathering in the cut corn at harvest time.

clue.text: Carrier of some oak cask currently being returned

indicators.note: the letters picked out are read from right to left, going back
only some of the letters of these words are taken, a run lying inside them

parts.note: the run sits across cask and the start of currently

explanation.surface: An oak barrel of drink currently being sent back to a supplier.
explanation.walkthrough: Read the letters K CASK CUR from 'oak cask currently' backwards.
explanation.definitionFit: A rucksack is a bag carried on the back, so it is a carrier for a hiker's gear.

clue.text: Like his eagle, first Roman emperor is this after October

indicators.note: the answer is what follows the month's short form in the emperor's name, so that short form is cut away

parts.note: Octavian, later Augustus, was the first Roman emperor
OCT is the calendar abbreviation for October

explanation.surface: A puzzle about the emperor and his eagle standard, posed as a riddle.
explanation.walkthrough: OCTAVIAN is OCT followed by this answer; 'his' points back to the emperor, whose legions carried the eagle standard.
explanation.definitionFit: An eagle is a bird, and avian means bird-like or relating to birds.

clue.text: On the up, exist for a long time

indicators.note: in a down clue, going up means the letters are read from the bottom

parts.note: things that exist are; we are

explanation.surface: Something on the rise that will exist for ages.
explanation.definitionFit: An era is an extended period of history, a long stretch of time.

clue.text: Hitch cables to rocks

indicators.note: to rock is to shake about, so these letters are jumbled into a new order

explanation.surface: Tying cables to rocks, as a climber or sailor might.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Hitch' reads as a verb to tie, but here it is the noun for a snag.
explanation.definitionFit: A hitch is a snag or difficulty, an obstacle in the way of progress.

clue.text: Article in vicar's home is jug for beer supply

indicators.note: the article in the place is made to be the jug instead, one swapped for the other

parts.note: the Vicar of Bray is the turncoat cleric of an old English song
A is the indefinite article
a ewer is a large water jug

explanation.surface: An item in the vicarage is a jug for serving beer.
explanation.walkthrough: The Vicar of Bray, from a traditional English song, lives in BRAY; its A becomes EWER.
explanation.definitionFit: A brewery produces beer and so supplies it to pubs and drinkers.

clue.text: Piano in broadcast Prom with a forte designed to beat fiddles?

indicators.note: something broadcast is scattered widely, so the letters are spread into a new order

parts.note: P is the musical abbreviation for piano, softly

explanation.surface: A Prom concert broadcast featuring piano and a loud passage.
explanation.walkthrough: Every music word is wordplay: P with PROM, A and FORTE is rearranged; the fiddles are frauds, not violins.
explanation.definitionFit: Something tamper-proof is built so no one can interfere with it, defeating fiddling or fraud.

clue.text: Isn't able to tolerate changing key for learner in singing piece

indicators.note: one letter of the phrase is changed, the key swapped for the learner

parts.note: can't abide means cannot tolerate
D is a musical key
L is the learner driver's plate

explanation.surface: Someone who can't stand it when a song changes key.
explanation.walkthrough: CAN'T ABIDE with the key D changed to L for learner.
explanation.definitionFit: Cantabile is a musical direction meaning in a smooth singing style, and also a passage played that way.

clue.text: Urge using tons for hours to squeeze out under pressure

indicators.note: using tons for hours means tons replaces hours, one letter standing in for another

parts.note: to exhort is to urge strongly

explanation.surface: A boss urging staff to work tons of hours under pressure.
explanation.definitionFit: To extort is to obtain money or something else by force or threats.

clue.text: Criminal charge that is right for weapon that is used to attack

definitions.text: weapon that is used to attack

parts.note: a rap is a criminal charge, as in a murder rap
i.e. is the abbreviation for id est, that is

explanation.surface: A police charge sheet listing an offensive weapon.
explanation.definitionFit: A rapier is a slender thrusting sword, a weapon for attacking an opponent.

clue.text: Porcelain bottom of mug with area damaged

parts.note: mug is slang for face, and the chin is at its bottom

indicators.note: something damaged is knocked out of shape, so these letters are reordered

explanation.surface: A broken porcelain cup with a chip in the base.
explanation.walkthrough: Mug means face, not cup: its bottom is CHIN; W and AREA rearranged give AWARE.
explanation.definitionFit: Chinaware is crockery made of china, which is porcelain.

clue.text: Artist working in opera house abroad

indicators.note: working is placed inside the name of the opera house

parts.note: the Met is New York's Metropolitan Opera
on means working, functioning

explanation.surface: A painter at work in a foreign opera house, perhaps on scenery.
explanation.definitionFit: Claude Monet was the French Impressionist painter of water lilies.

clue.text: Landlocked people being sensible keeping naval forces?

indicators.note: sensible holds the naval forces inside it

parts.note: sane means sensible, of sound mind
marines are soldiers serving with a navy

explanation.surface: An inland nation sensibly keeping a navy, with a wry question mark.
explanation.walkthrough: The question mark flags the joke: a landlocked state with marines.
explanation.definitionFit: San Marino is a tiny landlocked republic inside Italy, and its citizens are the Sammarinese, or San Marinese.

clue.text: Choice of temperature in beer supported by Esher's last local

indicators.note: in a down clue the beer sits above, propped up by what follows
temperature is placed inside the beer

parts.note: ale is beer

indicators.note: the last of Esher means only its closing letter is kept; Esher is a town in Surrey

parts.note: a native is a local person

explanation.surface: Picking a beer and its temperature in a pub in Esher, a Surrey town.
explanation.definitionFit: An alternative is an option one may choose instead of another.

clue.text: Broadcast appearance

definitions.meaning: first meaning: to put on the ..., transmit
second meaning: a manner or look

explanation.walkthrough: One verb for transmitting and one noun for a look or manner share the same three letters.
explanation.definitionFit: To air a programme is to transmit it, and an air of confidence is an outward look or manner.

clue.text: Supporter of glass company plant

parts.note: an aster is a daisy-like flowering plant

explanation.surface: A firm making glass and running a manufacturing plant.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Glass company' and 'plant' suggest industry, but the glass is a drinking glass.
explanation.definitionFit: A coaster is a small mat set under a drinking glass to protect the table.

clue.text: Hint at introduction of absolutely stupid measure

indicators.note: the introduction of a word is its opening letter

parts.note: dumb means stupid
a rate is a measure, as in rate of growth

explanation.surface: Bringing in a completely foolish policy measure.
explanation.definitionFit: To adumbrate is to outline or foreshadow, giving a faint indication of something.

clue.text: Young professional pup, one working in yen and euro

indicators.note: the jumbled letters are placed between the two currencies

parts.note: Y is the symbol for the Japanese yen

indicators.note: working means the letters are worked into a new order

parts.note: I is the Roman numeral one

explanation.surface: A puppy employed in the currency markets, dealing in yen and euros.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Working' looks like the pup's job, but it tells you to rearrange the pup.
explanation.definitionFit: Yuppie was the 1980s word for a well-paid young urban professional.

clue.text: White wine is palest somehow bottled in southeast

indicators.note: the jumbled letters are enclosed by southeast like wine in a bottle

parts.note: SE is the compass abbreviation for southeast

indicators.note: somehow means in some way or other, so the letters are rearranged

explanation.surface: A pale white wine bottled in the southeast of a country.
explanation.walkthrough: The German spelling has an umlaut on the A, ignored in the grid.
explanation.definitionFit: Spätlese is a German white wine made from late-harvested grapes.

clue.text: Volume perhaps a couple of pints over

parts.note: a quart is two pints
O is the cricket abbreviation for an over

explanation.surface: Measuring how much liquid there is, a couple of pints and more.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Volume' suggests capacity, but it is a book; 'perhaps' marks the example.
explanation.definitionFit: A quarto is a book size made by folding sheets twice, so a quarto is one kind of volume.

clue.text: Turk's short sentence that's overturned and finally annulled

indicators.note: in a down clue the words are turned upside down, read bottom to top

parts.note: a motto is a short pithy sentence

indicators.note: the final letter of the word is cancelled

explanation.surface: A Turkish court passing a brief sentence that is overturned and annulled.
explanation.walkthrough: MOTTO upside down is OTTOM; AND with its last letter cancelled is AN. The definition's 's is 'is': a Turk is an Ottoman.
explanation.definitionFit: Ottoman was the dynasty and empire of the Turks, so an Ottoman is a Turk.

clue.text: Slowly filter into bar returning for a drinking session

indicators.note: the slow-filtering word is put inside the other
returning means the bar is read back to front

parts.note: a pub is a bar
to ooze is to seep or flow slowly

explanation.surface: Drinkers slowly filtering back into the bar for another round.
explanation.definitionFit: A booze-up is a party or session of heavy drinking.

clue.text: Only just see after pub

indicators.note: the see comes after the pub in the answer

parts.note: a bar is a pub
Ely, a Cambridgeshire cathedral city, is a bishop's see

explanation.surface: Barely catching sight of something after leaving a pub.
explanation.walkthrough: 'See' is not to look but a bishop's seat: Ely.
explanation.definitionFit: Barely means scarcely, by the smallest margin.

clue.text: Volunteers leading Royal Marines and Air Corps? This is on the way

indicators.note: the volunteers come first, ahead of the other pieces

parts.note: TA is the Territorial Army, Britain's volunteer reserve

explanation.surface: Reserve soldiers leading marines and airmen, with reinforcements on the way.
explanation.walkthrough: The military units suggest troops on the move; the definition is the road surface itself.
explanation.definitionFit: Tarmac is the asphalt surfacing laid on roads, so it lies on the road.

clue.text: A large, black religious garment

parts.note: B is the abbreviation for black, as on pencils; the answer appearing backwards in this word is a coincidence

explanation.surface: A big black robe worn by a cleric.
explanation.definitionFit: An alb is a long white vestment worn by priests at the Eucharist.

clue.text: Fact fee fret funny further fruit?

indicators.note: something funny is odd or peculiar, so these letters are rearranged into an odd order

explanation.surface: A tongue-twisting string of F words, alliteration for its own sake.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Fruit' here means result, as in the fruits of one's labours.
explanation.definitionFit: An aftereffect is a later consequence of something, a further result coming after the first.

clue.text: Annoy a court, not very careful about details

indicators.note: not means the very letter is left out of the phrase

parts.note: to vex is to annoy

explanation.surface: A fussy litigant annoying a court by not being very careful.
explanation.walkthrough: VEX A CT with V removed leaves EXACT.
explanation.definitionFit: Exact describes someone precise and meticulous, attentive to fine points.

clue.text: I am back with friend in French city

indicators.note: the contraction is read backwards

parts.note: I am is shortened to I'm
ami is French for friend

explanation.surface: Someone returning to a French city to see a friend.
explanation.walkthrough: 'French city' looks like the definition, but French belongs to friend; I'M backwards gives MI.
explanation.definitionFit: Miami is a major city in Florida, USA.

clue.text: Gets all one can from fish drink

parts.note: to milk something is to exploit it fully
hake is a fish of the cod family

explanation.surface: An angler getting every last bit out of a fish.
explanation.definitionFit: A milkshake is a drink of milk whisked with flavouring or ice cream.

clue.text: Bashful's hot wearing Sleepy's coat

definitions.note: Bashful's means Bashful is, and the answer means bashful

indicators.note: hot is covered by the outer letters as if wearing a coat

parts.note: the outside letters of Sleepy, its coat
H is the abbreviation for hot, on taps

explanation.surface: Two of Snow White's seven dwarfs, Bashful hot in Sleepy's coat.
explanation.walkthrough: Bashful and Sleepy are two of the seven dwarfs; the 's on Bashful is 'is'.
explanation.definitionFit: Shy and bashful both mean timid and easily embarrassed.

clue.text: Revolutionary yearning to get new European state capital

parts.note: Che Guevara is the classic crossword revolutionary
a yen is a yearning

explanation.surface: A revolutionary longing to seize a new European capital city.
explanation.definitionFit: Cheyenne is the capital city of the US state of Wyoming.

clue.text: Both sides needing feet pruned on my shrub

indicators.note: in an across clue the rest is put on, after, the word my
pruned means the feet are cut off the end

parts.note: right and left, written RT LEFT

explanation.surface: A gardener pruning both sides of a hedge, trimming its base.
explanation.walkthrough: Both sides are right and left, RT and LEFT; cut FT from LEFT to leave RTLE.
explanation.definitionFit: Myrtle is an evergreen flowering bush with fragrant leaves.
